subject: get-shit-done
stack: Claude Code / OpenCode / Codex / Gemini CLI / Cursor / Windsurf / Cline / Copilot / Kilo / Qwen / CodeBuddy / Antigravity / Augment / Trae
tagline: Light-weight and powerful meta-prompting, context engineering and spec-driven development system — solves context rot (quality degradation as Claude fills its context window).

modules.name: commands
modules.description: 100+ slash commands for Claude Code (new-project, spec-phase, plan-phase, execute-phase, verify-work, ...)

modules.name: agents
modules.description: 32 specialized subagents (planner, executor, verifier, debugger, code-reviewer, researcher, nyquist-auditor, etc.)

modules.name: hooks
modules.description: 12 runtime hooks: context-monitor, prompt-guard, read-guard, workflow-guard, phase-boundary, validate-commit, session-state, statusline, check-update, read-injection-scanner

modules.name: workflows
modules.description: Workflow definitions that command files delegate to (plan-phase, execute-phase, spec-phase, etc.)

modules.name: templates
modules.description: Canonical artefact templates: spec.md, requirements.md, project.md, discovery.md, phase-prompt.md, verification-report.md, planner-subagent-prompt.md, UI-SPEC.md, AI-SPEC.md, SECURITY.md, UAT.md, VALIDATION.md, etc.

modules.name: references
modules.description: 50+ reference docs (thinking-models, gates, TDD, context-budget, planner-antipatterns, model-profiles, ...)

modules.name: sdk
modules.description: TypeScript SDK exposing GSD primitives (query, workstream, planning)

modules.name: bin/install.js
modules.description: Installer invoked via npx get-shit-done-cc@latest across 14 runtimes

modules.name: tests
modules.description: 213+ vitest test files covering agents, hooks, commands, gates, SDK

external_dependencies_top10.purpose: Runtime deps primarily devDependencies; GSD ships as a zero-runtime-dep installer + prompt/template bundle

entry_points.notes: Selects runtime (Claude Code, OpenCode, Codex, Gemini, Cursor, Windsurf, Cline, Copilot, Kilo, Qwen, CodeBuddy, Antigravity, Augment, Trae) and copies commands/agents/hooks
Socratic ambiguity-scored interview → SPEC.md per phase
Executor-ready plan with checklists, gates, rollback
Carries out plan under gate + hook enforcement
Brownfield import — scan codebase to seed planning context
Run multiple phases end-to-end (--auto, --to N, --interactive flags)

capabilities.name: Falsifiable requirements with current/target/acceptance
capabilities.description: Every requirement has Current state / Target state / pass-fail Acceptance criterion. Vague requirements rejected

capabilities.name: Spec → discuss → plan → execute → verify pipeline
capabilities.description: 5-stage pipeline with explicit handoffs; downstream agents treat upstream artefacts as locked

plugins.mechanism: Slash-command pack + agents pack + hooks pack installed per harness

unique_selling_points: Explicitly solves 'context rot' via context-monitor hook + Nyquist auditor
Meta-prompting with XML-formatted prompts + 32 subagents + state management
Falsifiable requirements with ambiguity-scoring gate (4 weighted dimensions)
Two drift detection layers: schema drift (ORM vs migrations) + STATE.md filesystem drift
Works across 14+ coding harnesses from a single npm package
Governance features: size-budget enforcement, scope reduction detection, security gates, claim provenance

limitations.description: No executable-spec → test generation — specs define acceptance criteria but do not auto-generate failing tests
limitations.source: get-shit-done/templates/spec.md (acceptance criteria are checkboxes, not executable)

limitations.description: Not a plugin inside a host runtime — installer-driven copy into each harness
Spec format is GSD-specific; not aligned with spec-kit requirement-ID conventions
